draft_text: Under matched inference conditions, Velora uses less peak GPU memory than Dravik, at 9.6 versus 14.8 GiB.
revised_text: Under matched inference conditions, Velora's peak GPU memory was measured at 9.6 GiB; Dravik's peak GPU memory was not measured, so a direct comparison of peak GPU memory is not established. The parameter counts (1.3 vs 2.4 billion) provide directional, indirect evidence about memory use.
rationale: T1 shows Velora's peak GPU memory = 9.6 GiB, but Dravik's mem cell = "Not measured" (T1.r2.mem).
